title: Creating Your First Repository & The Three-Stage Workflow
introduction: Today you create your very first Git repository! You will discover Git's most fundamental concept: the three areas that every file moves through — the Working Directory (your workspace), the Staging Area (preparing changes), and the Repository (permanent snapshots).
why_it_matters: Unlike a regular Save command which blindly overwrites a file, Git's two-step 'add then commit' flow gives you complete control over which changes are grouped into each permanent snapshot.
practical_activity_preview: Initialize a local repository, create a file, stage it, and make your first commit.
